title: Find the Student that Will Replace the Chalk
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array chalk where chalk[i] represents the number of chalk pieces required by the student numbered i, and an integer k representing the initial number of chalk pieces, determine the index of the student who will need to replace the chalk when the chalk count falls below the required amount for the next student.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array chalk where chalk[i] represents the number of chalk pieces required by the student numbered i, and an integer k representing the initial number of chalk pieces, determine the index of the student who will need to replace the chalk when the chalk count falls below the required amount for the next student. The teacher starts by giving the first student a problem, then the second, and so on, cycling through the students repeatedly until the chalk count is insufficient for the next student's requirement.
constraints: There are at most 100000 students and every chalk requirement is positive.
A student proceeds when exactly enough chalk remains; replacement occurs only when remaining chalk is smaller than the requirement.
hints: Whole class cycles always consume the same total chalk.
Reduce k modulo the sum of all requirements to skip every complete cycle.
Scan students once, returning before the first requirement larger than the remainder.
Modulo removes only complete cycles with identical state, and the final scan exactly simulates the remaining partial cycle.
editorial: Modulo removes only complete cycles with identical state, and the final scan exactly simulates the remaining partial cycle.

tests.explanation: Two full rounds use twenty-two pieces, leaving zero, so student zero replaces the chalk.
Two full rounds leave five; student zero uses three and student one then lacks four, so return one.
